summary: A deadlock occurs when a set of processes are blocked because each process holds a resource and waits for another held by someone else. Four Coffman conditions must hold simultaneously for a deadlock: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, and circular wait. A Resource Allocation Graph (RAG) is a directed graph where cycles indicate deadlocks if each resource type has a single instance. Systems can handle deadlocks through four methods: prevention by ensuring at least one condition never holds, avoidance using extra information such as the Banker's algorithm, detection and recovery, and ignorance using the ostrich algorithm. Additionally, a safe state allows the system to allocate resources to every process in a safe sequence avoiding deadlock, while an unsafe state may lead to a deadlock.

key_terms.definition: A deadlock is a situation where a set of processes are blocked because each process is holding a resource and waiting for another resource held by some other process in the set.
Mutual exclusion means at least one resource is non-sharable, so only one process can use it at a time.
Hold and wait occurs when a process holds at least one resource while waiting to acquire additional resources held by other processes.
No preemption means a resource can be released only voluntarily by the process holding it.
Circular wait is present when there is a set of processes where each waits for a resource held by the next process in the set.
A Resource Allocation Graph is a directed graph with process nodes and resource nodes where request edges go from processes to resources and assignment edges go from resources to processes.
Prevention involves making sure at least one of the four deadlock conditions can never hold.
Avoidance is a method where the operating system uses extra information about future requests to decide whether to grant a request.
The Banker's algorithm is an avoidance algorithm used by the operating system.
A safe state is a state in which the system can allocate resources to every process in some order and still avoid deadlock.
